messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] convert2riself
parts:
Please provide the code that you used. It's hard for us to explain what's going wrong without it.

You should be able to get by without convert2riself, by using the crosstype argument to read.cross:

mycross <- read.cross("csv", file="mydata.csv", genotypes=c("AA", "BB"), crosstype="riself")

karl
